description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) for two variants of the MADLLM model—“MADLLM” (light green bars) and “MADLLM w/o skip embedding” (light orange bars)—across five datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) on a linear scale ranging from 80 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10 percentage points. The horizontal axis lists the five datasets in alphabetical order. Each dataset has two adjacent bars: the light green bar represents MADLLM, and the light orange bar represents MADLLM without skip embedding. For SMD, the MADLLM score is approximately 93.5%, while the variant is approximately 90%. For PSM, MADLLM achieves approximately 97%, and the variant approximately 93%. For SWaT, MADLLM scores approximately 92%, and the variant approximately 87%. For SMAP, MADLLM scores approximately 93.5%, and the variant approximately 90%. For MSL, MADLLM scores approximately 93%, and the variant approximately 89%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the dataset labels on the horizontal axis. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
